statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail remains low while NQ is weekend-closed; Stress is extreme as fresh reporting indicates the Saudi pipeline outage could materially deepen the energy-supply shock.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next path-based evidence arrives at the Sunday Globex reopening, where gap persistence, retracement quality and cross-asset alignment determine whether conditional WATCH risk is reinforced or fades.
headline: Saudi pipeline outage deepens macro stress while closed NQ keeps current Tail low
body: NQ is weekend-closed, so persistent one-way price-path evidence is unavailable. Reuters reports the Saudi East-West pipeline outage could threaten up to 4% of global oil supply if not restarted within days, with some repair estimates extending to five or six weeks. This raises gap, inflation and yield Stress without proving persistent Nasdaq mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock hours have published ChatGPT assessments. Tail remained 19%; Stress rose from 98% to 100% as Gulf energy-route disruption intensified, while Confidence stayed 98% and dominantMode remained normal.
outlookSummary: Conditional risk is concentrated from 19:00 UTC through the early post-reopen hours. Forecast Tail peaks at 24% WATCH around Globex because the price path is still unobserved; 25%+ would require actual persistent extension, failed retracements or multiple aligned current amplifiers.
